'''Peter Lucas Nance''' (born February 19, 2000),<ref>{{cite web|title=NU Sports - Pete Nance - 2018-19 - Northwestern University|url=https://nusports.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=7986&path=mbball|work=[[Northwestern Wildcats]]|access-date=December 3, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181220234745/https://nusports.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=7986&path=mbball|archive-date=December 20, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball|Northwestern Wildcats]] and [[North Carolina Tar Heels basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]]. He has played in the NBA for the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] and [[Philadelphia 76ers]].

==College career==
===Northwestern===
[[File:20200212 Pete Nance in front of Pat Spencer.jpg|thumb|upright|left|Nance for [[2019–20 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]] on February 12, 2020]]
Nance debuted in an exhibition game against the [[McKendree Bearcats]], during which he notched 12 points, eight rebounds, three blocks and four steals in 19 minutes off the bench.<ref>{{cite web|title=Box Score for Men's Basketball vs McKendree (Exhibition) on 11/2/2018|url=https://nusports.com/boxscore.aspx?path=mbball&id=15316|work=[[Northwestern Wildcats]]|date=November 2, 2018|access-date=December 20, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181220234134/https://nusports.com/boxscore.aspx?path=mbball&id=15316|archive-date=December 20, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> In his first regular-season college basketball game, Nance scored three points and provided one assist in a win against the [[New Orleans Privateers men's basketball|New Orleans Privateers]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Box Score for Men's Basketball vs New Orleans on 11/8/2018|url=https://nusports.com/boxscore.aspx?path=mbball&id=15317|work=[[Northwestern Wildcats]]|date=November 8, 2018|access-date=December 20, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181220234541/https://nusports.com/boxscore.aspx?path=mbball&id=15317|archive-date=December 20, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> Nance earned his first collegiate start in an 80–60 loss to the [[2018–19 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan Wolverines]].<ref>{{cite news|first=Charlie|last=Goldsmith|title=Men's Basketball: Michigan routs Northwestern the second time around|url=https://dailynorthwestern.com/2019/01/14/sports/mens-basketball-michigan-routs-northwestern-the-second-time-around/|work=[[The Daily Northwestern]]|date=January 14, 2019|access-date=May 30, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190530145307/https://dailynorthwestern.com/2019/01/14/sports/mens-basketball-michigan-routs-northwestern-the-second-time-around/|archive-date=May 30, 2019|url-status=live}}</ref> He averaged 8.5 points and 6.0 rebounds per game as a sophomore.<ref>{{cite web|first=Austin|last=Fox|title=Big Ten Basketball Preview: Ranking The League's Teams 1-14|url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/big-ten-basketball-preview-ranking-the-league-s-teams-1-14|website=Rivals.com|date=October 1, 2020|access-date=January 16, 2022|archive-date=January 18, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220118184320/https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/big-ten-basketball-preview-ranking-the-league-s-teams-1-14|url-status=dead}}</ref> As a junior, Nance averaged 11.1 points, 6.8 rebounds and 1.8 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web|first=Bradley|last=Locker|title=Northwestern men's basketball 2021-22 player previews: Pete Northwestern Stuns Michigan State in East Lansing, Wins 64-62|url=https://www.si.com/college/indiana/basketball/big-ten-roundup-january-15-michigan-state-loses-first-league-game-to-northwestern-ron-harper-rutgers-31-points|work=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=January 15, 2022|access-date=January 16, 2022}}</ref>

Nance averaged 14.6 points and 6.5 rebounds per game as a senior. After testing the waters in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Nance ultimately returned to college and transferred to [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]].<ref>{{cite news|first=Steve|last=Kirschner|title=Pete Nance joins men's basketball team|url=https://goheels.com/news/2022/6/20/pete-nance-joins-mens-basketball-team.aspx|website=GoHeels.com|date=June 20, 2022|access-date=June 20, 2022}}</ref>

===North Carolina===
[[File:Pete Nance UNC (cropped).jpg|thumb|left|150px|Nance with [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] in 2022]]
Nance transferred to North Carolina to play in his fifth collegiate season, joining a team that had been national runners-up the season prior. He was able to join the Tar Heels due to an NCAA rule granting all student-athletes an extra year of eligibility because of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] shutting down sports at the end of the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]]. Immediately becoming a starter and a key part of the rotation, Nance and the Tar Heels struggled through an up-and-down season. Hampered by a nagging back injury that kept him out of a few games, Nance started all 30 games in which he played as a Tar Heel. He averaged 10 points and 6 rebounds per game, and shot 42% from the floor in his lone season in Chapel Hill.<ref>{{cite web|title=Pete Nance College Basketball Stats|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/stats/_/id/4397233/type/mens-college-basketball|website=ESPN.com|access-date=February 15, 2024}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Cleveland Cavaliers / Charge (2023–2024)===
After going undrafted in the [[2023 NBA draft]], Nance joined the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] for the [[2023 NBA Summer League]] and on September 13, 2023, he signed with the Cavaliers.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Sharife Cooper, Pete Nance, and Justin Powell to Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/releases-training-camp-signings-230913|website=NBA.com|date=September 13, 2023|access-date=September 13, 2023}}</ref> However, he was waived on October 21<ref>{{cite web|first=Arthur|last=Hill|title=Cavaliers Waive Seven Players|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/10/cavaliers-waive-seven-players.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 21, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2023}}</ref> and one week later, signed with the [[Cleveland Charge]] of the [[NBA G League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Cleveland Charge 2023 Training Camp Roster|url=https://cleveland.gleague.nba.com/news/cleveland-charge-2023-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2023}}</ref>

On January 18, 2024, Nance signed a 10-day contract with the Cleveland Cavaliers,<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Pete Nance to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/releases-pete-nance-signing-240118|website=NBA.com|date=January 18, 2024|access-date=January 18, 2024}}</ref> making him the third member of the Nance family to play for the Cavaliers (after his father Larry and brother Larry Jr.).<ref>{{cite web|first=Camryn|last=Justice|title=A dream come true': Pete Nance fulfills life-long dream of playing for Cavs with 10-day contract|url=https://www.news5cleveland.com/sports/basketball/cavaliers/a-dream-come-true-pete-nance-fulfills-life-long-dream-of-playing-for-cavs-with-10-day-contract|work=News 5 Cleveland (WEWS-TV)|date=January 19, 2024|access-date=January 19, 2024}}</ref> On January 30, he returned to the Cleveland Charge<ref>{{cite web|title=Charge Make Roster Moves|url=https://cleveland.gleague.nba.com/news/charge-make-roster-moves|website=NBA.com|date=January 30, 2024|access-date=January 31, 2024}}</ref> and on February 19, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Cavaliers.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Pete Nance to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/releases-pete-nance-two-way-240219|website=NBA.com|date=February 19, 2024|access-date=February 19, 2024}}</ref>

On September 24, 2024, Nance signed a standard contract with the Cavaliers,<ref>{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Cavs Adding Four Players To Fortify Camp Roster|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/cavs-adding-four-players-to-fortify-camp-roster.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 23, 2024|access-date=September 24, 2024}}</ref> but was waived on October 19.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Waive Four Players|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/releases-roster-update-241019|website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 19, 2024}}</ref> Seven days later, he re-joined the Charge.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cleveland Charge 2024 Training Camp Roster|url=https://cleveland.gleague.nba.com/news/cleveland-charge-2024-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 26, 2024|access-date=October 26, 2024}}</ref>

===Philadelphia 76ers / Delaware Blue Coats / Return to the Charge (2024–2025)===
On December 3, 2024, Nance signed a two-way contract with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Philadelphia 76ers Sign Pete Nance to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/76ers-sign-pete-nance-two-way-contract-dec-2024|website=NBA.com|date=December 3, 2024|access-date=December 3, 2024}}</ref> However, he was waived on January 7, 2025<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Philadelphia 76ers|title=We have waived Pete Nance.|number=1876751229017071803|user=sixers|date=January 7, 2025|access-date=January 7, 2025}}</ref> and three days later, Nance returned to the [[Cleveland Charge]].<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Cleveland Charge|title=Welcome back to CLE @peteln22!! #ChargeUp|number=1877852939408028038|user=ChargeCLE|date=January 10, 2025|access-date=January 12, 2025}}</ref> On January 14, he signed another two-way contract with Philadelphia.<ref>{{cite web|title=Philadelphia 76ers Sign Pete Nance to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/76ers-sign-pete-nance-to-two-way-contract-jan-2025|website=NBA.com|date=January 14, 2025|access-date=January 14, 2025}}</ref>

On February 6, 2025, Nance was waived, as part of the [[Jared Butler]] trade.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76ers-acquire-jared-butler-four-draft-picks-from-washington-wizards|title=Philadelphia 76ers Acquire Jared Butler and Four Draft Picks From Washington Wizards|work=NBA.com|date=February 6, 2025|quote=In a related move, the 76ers waived two-way player Pete Nance.}}</ref>

=== Milwaukee Bucks (2025–present) ===
On February 28, 2025, Nance signed a two-way contract with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=February 28, 2025 |title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Pete Nance to Two-Way Contract |url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-pete-nance-to-two-way-contract |access-date=2025-02-28 |website=NBA.com |language=en}}</ref> He made six appearances (including one start) during the remainder of the year, averaging 3.8 points, 1.8 rebounds, and 1.2 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pete Nance 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397233/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=April 19, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref>

On March 23, 2026, the Bucks converted Nance's two-way contract into a multiyear standard contract.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bucks convert Pete Nance to standard deal, waive Cam Thomas|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/bucks-convert-pete-nance-standard-015627058.html|access-date=April 19, 2026|website=sports.yahoo.com|language=en}}</ref> Nance made 47 total appearances (including six starts) for Milwaukee in the [[2025–26 NBA season]], recording averages of 5.4 points, 2.7 rebounds, and 1.0 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pete Nance 2025-26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397233/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=April 19, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref>

On July 3, 2026, the Bucks waived Nance before his salary for the 2026–27 season became fully guaranteed.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Amico|first=Sam|date=July 3, 2026|title=Bucks waive Pete Nance ahead of guarantee date|url=https://hoopswire.com/bucks-waive-pete-nance-ahead-of-guarantee-date/|access-date=July 4, 2026|website=Hoops Wire}}</ref> On July 9, he re–signed with Milwaukee on a two–year contract.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Pete Nance|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-pete-nance|access-date=August 12, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}}</ref>
